accessible_exit_control_note: Sign-out, safe-exit, and shared-device guidance remain available in accessible text on mobile, at zoom, with keyboard navigation, and with screen readers.
delivery_role_note: Official voter-information routes that expose personalized or sensitive voter-specific state keep sign-out, safe-exit, shared-device risk, and local-data-clearing posture clear enough that the voter does not have to guess how to end the session safely on a borrowed, family-shared, library, school, or shelter device.
logout_vs_local_clear_note: The route review distinguishes ending the authenticated session from clearing browser-side state, and documents what local clearing is reviewed or supported.
post_logout_confirmation_note: After sign-out or safe exit, the route makes it visible that the session has ended and gives a bounded next step if the voter still needs official help.
resume_privacy_boundary_note: If save/resume or remembered state exists, the route explains enough about that persistence boundary that shared-device use does not silently expose draft or status data to the next user.
shared_device_exit_surface_label: Example State official voter-information sign-out and shared-device safe-exit policy
shared_device_risk_note: The route acknowledges when the user may be on a shared or borrowed device and does not assume a private personal browser context.
shared_or_public_device_guidance_note: The route gives ordinary-language shared-device guidance at the point of finishing or leaving the personalized answer lane.
visible_sign_out_or_safe_exit_note: A visible sign-out or safe-exit action is available wherever the route exposes personalized or sensitive voter-specific state.
